description: Starter doctrinal concepts. These are review references, not authoritative interpretations or target-language prescriptions.

entries.notes: Preserve the source passage's meaning and its relationship to Jesus Christ; do not substitute an unrelated concept.
Keep covenant distinct from a casual promise when the passage makes that distinction.
Preserve the theological sense indicated by context; do not flatten it to generic kindness without evidence.
Check that the translation preserves the source passage's redemption or deliverance concept.
Preserve the passage's meaning about resurrection; flag omission or conflation with a different concept.
Retain the contextual meaning of faith; distinguish it from mere opinion when supported by the text.
Preserve the source's religious-practice sense when context supports it.
